adventure.name: Tool — The Lost Archive
adventure.description: Somewhere beneath the Band Spectrum Archive, four sealed vaults hold the scattered remnants of a legendary collection. Descend through the Archive Entrance, the Undertow Vault, the Ænima Chamber, and the Spiral Gate to recover what was lost.

items.name: Archive Key
items.description: A heavy iron key, its bow shaped like a spiral. It opens the door to the Undertow Vault.

items.name: Rusty Reel
items.description: A corroded tape reel, its label worn beyond reading. The magnetic oxide has degraded, but the format is unmistakable — two-inch, 24-track.

items.name: Undertow Seal
items.description: A wax seal stamped with the symbol of the first vault. It opens the passage to the Ænima Chamber.

items.name: Recovered Vinyl — Undertow
items.description: A pristine pressing from the Undertow collection. The original sleeve is worn but the vinyl beneath is unplayed. Titles are listed in the catalogue: Prison Sex, Sober, Bottom, and others.

items.name: Chamber Fuse
items.description: A glass fuse recovered from the Ænima Chamber's damaged electrical panel. Collectible; documents the flood damage.

items.name: Flooded Tape
items.description: A waterlogged reel recovered from the lower shelves of the Ænima Chamber. The casing is cracked but the contents — session annotation cards from the Ænima period — may be salvageable.

items.name: Recovered Vinyl — Ænima
items.description: A double-LP from the Ænima collection. The gate-fold sleeve is damp at the edges but the records inside are perfect. Two discs, side-by-side in the centre pocket.

items.name: Ænima Seal
items.description: A wax seal stamped with the symbol of the second vault. It opens the passage to the Spiral Gate.

items.name: Spiral Seal
items.description: The final seal — a golden disc embossed with a ten-thousand-hand spiral. This is what the Archive has been protecting.

arcs.title: The Descent
arcs.description: The player enters the Archive and begins the descent through the vaults.

arcs.title: The Recovery
arcs.description: The lost recordings are recovered and the Spiral Seal is claimed.

quests.name: Find the Archive Key
quests.description: The Curator needs you to find the Archive Key hidden in the entrance hall. It opens the Undertow Vault.

reward.message: You found the Archive Key. The Undertow Vault door will open now.

quests.name: Vault Recovery
quests.description: The Vault Keeper needs you to recover the Undertow vinyl and collect the Undertow Seal from the vaults below.

reward.message: The Undertow collection has been recovered. The Ænima Chamber awaits.

quests.name: The Chamber's Secret
quests.description: The Chamber Witness asks you to recover the Ænima vinyl and the Ænima Seal from the flooded chamber.

reward.message: The Ænima collection is recovered. Only the Spiral Gate remains.

quests.name: The Final Archive
quests.description: The Archivist asks you to claim the Spiral Seal — the final piece of the Lost Archive.

reward.message: The Spiral Seal is yours. The Lost Archive is complete.

levels.name: The Archive Entrance
levels.description: The grand entrance to the restricted collection. Towering shelves line every wall. A robed figure waits at the far end — they have been expecting you.

objectives.name: Speak with The Curator
objectives.description: The figure at the far end of the hall seems to know what's going on.

objectives.name: Find the Archive Key
objectives.description: The Curator says a key is hidden in the eastern shelves.

defaultDialogue.text: You've come. Good. I wasn't sure anyone would.
This archive holds recordings that were never meant to be lost. Four collections, sealed away across four vaults beneath this hall.
The key to the first vault is hidden somewhere in the eastern shelves. Look near the top.
Recover what was placed down there. Each vault has its own keeper. Listen to them.

lines.text: You push open the heavy doors of the Archive Entrance.
The room is vast and cold. Towering shelves rise on all sides, packed with reels, records, and annotated boxes.
At the far end, a robed figure glances up. They have been expecting you.
Your hand closes around a heavy iron key. The bow is shaped like a spiral.
The Vault door to the east shudders. Something deep inside the Archive is listening.

levels.name: The Undertow Vault
levels.description: A deep, low-ceilinged vault beneath the Archive Entrance. Shelves of early recordings line the walls. The air smells of magnetic tape and something older.

objectives.name: Speak with the Vault Keeper
objectives.description: Find the keeper of this vault and learn what must be recovered.

objectives.name: Recover the Undertow vinyl
objectives.description: The primary recording is shelved at the far north-east end.

objectives.name: Collect the Undertow Seal
objectives.description: The seal will open the passage to the next chamber.

defaultDialogue.text: You made it through the entrance. Not many do.
This is the Undertow Vault. The earliest material in the collection — foundational recordings, before anything was widely heard.
The primary vinyl is in the north-east shelving. There are also some older reels scattered about — take what you can carry.
And find the Undertow Seal. It's on one of the centre shelves. You'll need it to reach the Ænima Chamber beyond.

lines.text: You descend into the Undertow Vault.
The shelves here are older. The labels have faded, but you can still make out the catalogue numbers.
Something about this room feels unresolved — like music that ended before it was ready to.
The vinyl is in your hands. It is heavier than you expected.
You can feel the grooves through the sleeve — a record that waited years to be heard again.
The Undertow Seal clicks into your palm.
The passage to the Ænima Chamber unseals with a low mechanical resonance.
The deeper you go, the further back the archive reaches.
The archive lever grinds. Deep in the vault wall, something shifts.
The Ænima Chamber passage opens.

puzzles.name: Undertow seal collected — set world state
Undertow vinyl recovered — set world state
Vault lever pulled — mark world state

levels.name: The Ænima Chamber
levels.description: A flooded chamber at the heart of the Archive. Water has seeped in from above, warping the lower shelves. Somewhere above the waterline, two recordings remain intact.

objectives.name: Find the Chamber Witness
objectives.description: Someone has been watching over this chamber. Find them.

objectives.name: Recover the Ænima vinyl
objectives.description: The Witness says the double-LP is in the north-east shelving, above the waterline.

objectives.name: Collect the Ænima Seal
objectives.description: The seal is in the south-east shelving. It opens the Spiral Gate.

defaultDialogue.text: This chamber took on water two years ago. Most of the lower shelves are ruined.
But the Ænima collection was stored high. Both discs should still be intact — north-east corner, above the waterline.
The Ænima Seal is in the south-east shelving. Take both. You will need the seal to reach the Spiral Gate.
There is also a fuse and some old session materials floating around the upper shelves. Take what you find.

lines.text: You step into the Ænima Chamber. A thin film of water covers the floor.
The shelves above the waterline are intact. Below, the damage is extensive — tape boxes bloated, labels dissolved.
A figure sits on a dry step in the corner, watching.
The Ænima vinyl is intact. The double-LP gate-fold is damp at the edges, but the records inside are pristine.
The Ænima Seal is in your hands. The door to the Spiral Gate unlocks with a resonant click.
One vault remains.

puzzles.name: Chamber fuse collected — set world state
Ænima vinyl recovered — set world state
Ænima seal collected — set world state

levels.name: The Spiral Gate
levels.description: The deepest vault in the Archive. The air here is perfectly dry and perfectly still. A single pedestal stands at the centre, waiting.

objectives.name: Find The Archivist
objectives.description: Someone guards the final vault. Find them and hear what they have to say.

objectives.name: Claim the Spiral Seal
objectives.description: The final piece of the collection stands at the centre of the vault.

defaultDialogue.text: You have made it to the Spiral Gate. Few do.
This vault holds the Spiral Seal — the index of everything that was collected and catalogued. Without it, the archive is just noise.
Claim it. Carry it back. Everything you've recovered — the vinyls, the reels, the tapes — it all means something now.
The seal is on the pedestal at the centre of the room. It has been waiting for you.

lines.text: You step into the Spiral Gate.
The room is circular. Polished stone. No shelves — just the floor, the ceiling, and a single pedestal at the centre.
On it, something golden catches the light.
You lift the Spiral Seal from the pedestal.
The moment your hand closes around it, you hear something — faint, distant, like music through a wall.
The Lost Archive is complete.
Whatever was scattered across these four vaults — it is recovered. Preserved. Remembered.

puzzles.name: Spiral Seal claimed — mark archive complete
